The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? (Psalm 27:1) ☕ Let the warmth of His presence fill your cup and your heart today.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control. (Galatians 5:22-23) ☕ Pouring a cup of patience and kindness this morning.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. (Ecclesiastes 3:11) ☕ Just like a perfectly roasted bean, trust in God’s perfect timing.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing. (1 Thessalonians 5:11) ☕ Coffee is good, but uplifting fellowship is even better.
For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also. (Matthew 6:21) ☕ Starting the day focusing on what truly matters.
You are the salt of the earth... You are the light of the world. (Matthew 5:13-14) ☕ Bring flavor and warmth to the world today, just like a hot morning brew.
Be still, and know that I am God. (Psalm 46:10) ☕ Take a quiet moment, sip slowly, and let His peace wash over you.
A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones. (Proverbs 17:22) ☕ Brew a smile and share a laugh with your coffee today!
May the Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you. (Numbers 6:24-25) ☕ A fresh blessing for a brand new day.
Let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us, fixing our eyes on Jesus. (Hebrews 12:1-2) ☕ One sip at a time, one step at a time, running with faith.
I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds. (Psalm 9:1) ☕ Letting our praise overflow like a freshly poured cup.
Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. (Matthew 11:28) ☕ Find true rest for your soul in Him this morning.
But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord. (Joshua 24:15) ☕ Dedicating our homes, our hearts, and our mornings to the Lord.
Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken. (Psalm 55:22) ☕ Trust God with the heavy things while you hold your warm cup.
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights. (James 1:17) ☕ Every morning, every breath, and every warm cup is a gift from Him.
This is my command: Love each other. (John 15:17) ☕ Warm coffee, warm hearts, and a mandate to love those around us.
The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth. (Psalm 145:18) ☕ A morning prayer is only a whisper away.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. (Romans 12:2) ☕ A fresh morning brew to renew your mind and focus on Him.

I lift up my eyes to the mountains—where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth. (Psalm 121:1-2) ☕ Looking up and finding help and strength for the day ahead.
For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding. (Proverbs 2:6) ☕ Seeking His wisdom to start our day off right.
Your love, Lord, reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies. (Psalm 36:5) ☕ His love is higher than the sky and warmer than any brew.
Commit your way to the Lord; trust in him and he will do this. (Psalm 37:5) ☕ Handing the schedule of the day over to the Master Planner.
Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits. (Psalm 103:2) ☕ Counting our blessings this morning over a warm cup.
A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity. (Proverbs 17:17) ☕ Tag a friend you’d love to share a warm brew with today!
For nothing will be impossible with God. (Luke 1:37) ☕ Starting the day with faith that can move mountains.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. (Psalm 46:1) ☕ Standing strong today, knowing our refuge is secure.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, O Lord. (Psalm 19:14) ☕ A morning prayer for kind words and positive thoughts.
As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord’s word is flawless. (Psalm 18:30) ☕ Embracing God's perfect plan for us today.
Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him. (Jeremiah 17:7) ☕ Placing our ultimate confidence in His unfailing hands.
So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God. (1 Corinthians 10:31) ☕ Making even our morning coffee a moment of gratitude to Him.
Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances. (1 Thessalonians 5:16-18) ☕ A daily recipe for joy: rejoice, pray, and give thanks.
